hostname: countprimary
    entrypoint: &sqlserver_entrypoint
      - /bin/bash
      - -c
      - |
        # Keep INT effective for asynchronously started children; signal PIDs, never groups.
        set -m
        sql_pid=
        setup_pid=
        signal_epoch=0
        term_pending=0
        int_pending=0
        forward_signal() {
          local sig="$$1" child
          for child in "$$sql_pid" "$$setup_pid"; do
            if [[ -n "$$child" ]]; then
              kill -s "$$sig" -- "$$child" 2>/dev/null || :
            fi
          done
        }
        on_signal() {
          signal_epoch=$$((signal_epoch + 1))
          case "$$1" in
            TERM) term_pending=1 ;;
            INT) int_pending=1 ;;
          esac
          forward_signal "$$1"
        }
        replay_signals() {
          if (( term_pending )); then kill -s TERM -- "$$1" 2>/dev/null || :; fi
          if (( int_pending )); then kill -s INT -- "$$1" 2>/dev/null || :; fi
        }
        wait_child() {
          local target="$$1" epoch rc
          while :; do
            epoch=$$signal_epoch
            wait -f "$$target"
            rc=$$?
            # A trapped signal interrupts wait; retry the SAME child for its actual status.
            if (( epoch == signal_epoch )); then return "$$rc"; fi
          done
        }
        trap 'on_signal TERM' TERM
        trap 'on_signal INT' INT
        if [[ ! -x /opt/mssql/bin/permissions_check.sh ]]; then
          echo 'Unable to run startup permissions check, exiting.' >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        /opt/mssql/bin/permissions_check.sh
        startup_status=$$?
        if (( startup_status != 0 )); then exit "$$startup_status"; fi
        case "$${MSSQL_PID,,}" in
          standarddeveloper) export MSSQL_PID=DeveloperStandard ;;
          enterprisedeveloper) export MSSQL_PID=Developer ;;
        esac
        source /opt/mssql/bin/init_custom_setup.sh
        startup_status=$$?
        if (( startup_status != 0 )); then exit "$$startup_status"; fi
        if (( term_pending )); then exit 143; fi
        if (( int_pending )); then exit 130; fi
        /opt/mssql/bin/sqlservr &
        sql_pid=$$!
        # Replay signals received between launch and capture of the owned child PID.
        replay_signals "$$sql_pid"
        setup_status=0
        if (( !term_pending && !int_pending )); then
          /opt/mssql/bin/run_custom_setup.sh &
          setup_pid=$$!
          replay_signals "$$setup_pid"
          wait_child "$$setup_pid"
          setup_status=$$?
          setup_pid=
        fi
        if (( setup_status != 0 )); then
          # Failed startup must not abandon the SQL child it already started.
          kill -s TERM -- "$$sql_pid" 2>/dev/null || :
        fi
        wait_child "$$sql_pid"
        sql_status=$$?
        sql_pid=
        printf 'manual100m entrypoint terminal: setup=%s sql=%s\n' "$$setup_status" "$$sql_status"
        if (( sql_status != 0 )); then exit "$$sql_status"; fi
        if (( setup_status != 0 )); then exit "$$setup_status"; fi
        exit "$$sql_status"

def self.sqlserver_pids!(top)
    top.lines.drop(1).filter_map do |line|
      pid, comm, args = line.strip.split(/\s+/, 3)
      next unless comm == 'sqlservr' && args && args.split(/\s+/, 2).first == '/opt/mssql/bin/sqlservr'
      raise 'untrusted docker top pid' unless /\A[1-9][0-9]*\z/.match?(pid)
      pid
    end.uniq
  end
  def self.terminal_server!(state, started)

def runtime_rosetta(name = PREFIX, readiness: 120)
    server_id = @ids.fetch(['container', name])
    stop = [now + readiness, @deadline].min
    budget = lambda do
      remaining = stop - now
      raise 'SQL server process readiness deadline' unless remaining.positive?
      [10, remaining].min
    end
    loop do
      raw, = docker('container', 'inspect', server_id, seconds: budget.call)
      server = JSON.parse(raw).fetch(0)
      ManualModel.owned!('container', server, @owner, server_id)
      raise 'SQL server stopped before Rosetta proof' unless server.dig('State', 'Running')
      top, = docker('top', server_id, '-eo', 'pid,comm,args', seconds: budget.call)
      pids = ManualModel.sqlserver_pids!(top)
      unless pids.empty?
        executables = pids.to_h do |pid|
          # Numeric PID belongs to an actual sqlservr comm/argv in this pinned container.
          [pid, vm("sudo -n readlink /proc/#{pid}/exe", "#{name}-pid-#{pid}-exe", seconds: budget.call).strip]
        end
        raise 'actual SQL server interpreter is not Rosetta (QEMU forbidden)' unless executables.values.all? { |exe| exe.include?('rosetta') && !exe.downcase.include?('qemu') }
        confirmed_top, = docker('top', server_id, '-eo', 'pid,comm,args', seconds: budget.call)
        raise 'SQL process identity changed during Rosetta proof' unless ManualModel.sqlserver_pids!(confirmed_top).sort == pids.sort
        (@result['actual_sqlserver_rosetta'] ||= {})[name] = { 'container_id' => server_id, 'owner' => @owner,
          'docker_top' => top, 'docker_top_confirmed' => confirmed_top, 'pid_executables' => executables }
        return
      end
      remaining = stop - now
      raise 'SQL server process readiness deadline' unless remaining.positive?
      sleep [1, remaining].min
    end
  end
